A crucial win for the Bulls!
After posting just 98 in their allotted 10 overs, UAE Bulls bounced back with a sensational bowling effort to restrict United Tigers to 70. Leading the charge was Shadab Khan, who delivered a brilliant spell of 3/7 to help the Bulls seal an important victory!
